svg.title: Campaign Targeting
svg.desc: Top-20% precision is 60.7%, versus 31.6% in the held-out population (1.92x lift). Holdout ROC AUC: 0.729; average precision: 0.553. Treat the ranking as a pilot candidate, subject to consent, fairness review and an incremental-effect experiment. First 80% of original ordered rows train, last 20% test; the dataset has no complete timestamp for every record. Duration, current-campaign contact count, demographics and current contact timing are excluded. Remaining financial variables may still create fairness risks. No profit or causal uplift claim; historic selection and temporal shifts affect results.
